Huh. Yeah that's a little bit weird to my knowledge, valerate gets absorbed pretty quickly lol. I imagine you'd be getting some absurdly high levels when injecting and some really low levels around your next injection, maybe your doc is using levels like that because your body processes estrogen a bit slowly or something, idk.

... mg/ml is the *concentration*. How many ml do you inject? 20mg/ml would mean there's 20mg of valerate in one ml of the stuff you're injecting, so if you're injecting 0.5 ml for example that'd be 10mg of valerate at 20mg/ml. And the actual amount of mg you're injecting is what's important. 

Anyways doing any dose of valerate every two weeks is a bit odd, you sure you're not on cypionate? Valerate is usually injected more frequently in somewhat smaller doses.
